terrain.soil_characteristics: Weathered silty-colluvial overburden over jointed bedrock

identification.event_name: Sindhupalchok Glacial Lake Outburst Flood Event (Trishuli Basin)

terrain.geology: Precambrian to Paleozoic Metasediments, Phyllite, Schist, and Weathered Colluvium
terrain.soil_characteristics: Weathered silty-colluvial overburden over jointed bedrock
terrain.drainage_pattern: High-gradient mountain torrent with dendritic feeder gullies

environmental_conditions.lake_expansion_rate: Area expanded by 56% over preceding 15 years
environmental_conditions.moraine_characteristics: Sharp-crested unconsolidated terminal moraine with buried ice core
environmental_conditions.vegetation_and_land_cover: Steep mountainous forest / sparse alpine vegetation

trigger_and_mechanism.primary_trigger: Ice/rock avalanche into proglacial lake inducing displacement wave overtopping
trigger_and_mechanism.initiating_event: Hydrological saturation or mechanical overload of shear plane
trigger_and_mechanism.physical_mechanism: Moraine or ice dam failure releasing impounded glacial lake volume into gorge

impacts.communication_disruption: VHF and fiber optic lines severed along transport corridor
impacts.environmental_impacts: Severe riparian habitat smothering and sediment pulse

warning_and_response.evacuation_information: Local administrative evacuation executed
warning_and_response.response_measures: Search and rescue deployed by disaster response forces (NDRF/SDRF/Armed forces)
warning_and_response.infrastructure_protection: River training levees and culvert clearing implemented post-event
warning_and_response.documented_response_gaps: Lack of real-time sub-surface telemetry and sparse valley rain gauge coverage

lessons.what_happened: A catastrophic Glacial Lake Outburst Flood (GLOF) occurred in the Trishuli basin on 2022-05-13.
lessons.why_did_it_happen: Failure resulted from moraine or ice dam failure releasing impounded glacial lake volume into gorge under severe hydro-meteorological loading.
lessons.observable_indicators: High-altitude cloud accumulation, rising pore moisture, and tributary discharge turbidity.
lessons.overlooked_factors: Antecedent 72-hour moisture saturation memory and sub-surface fracture dilation.
lessons.mitigation_measures: Automated multi-depth pore-pressure telemetry and real-time community alert sirens.
lessons.unavailable_information: High-resolution real-time rainfall data at mountain crests above 2000m.
lessons.terrain_comparability_lessons: Comparable steep valleys across the Himalayan arc exhibit identical threshold sensitivities.
